sentences.text:
This is the first application filed by the applicant under Section 482 of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita , 2023/Section 438 of Cr.P.C., 1973 seeking anticipatory bail in connection with Crime No.26 of 2025 for the offence punishable under Sections 420, 467, 468 and 471 of the Indian Penal Code, registered at Police Station-Khargapur, District-Tikamgarh (M.P.).
2.

Learned counsel for applicant has submitted that in Village- Ramsagra, Tahsil-Kargapur, survey numbers 484, 484/31, 484/32, 484/36, 487, 489, 490, 496, 504/1, 506, 512, 514, 516, 518 total 31 khasras, area 9.572 Hectare were mutated in the ownership of Bhoomi Samohik Shahkari Samiti Maryadit Ramsagra and the name of the private parties were wrongly entered by the ID of Patwari in the name of Bhagwati, W/o Thakur Das NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:42892 2 MCRC-38818-2025 Yadav, Pratap, s/o Thakur Das Yadav, Rachna, W/o Mahendra Yadav,
Mahendra, s/o Thakur Das Yadav, Manoj Yadav, hence, the applicant be released on anticipatory bail.
3. Learned counsel for State has opposed the bail application and has submitted that investigation is going on, hence, applicant is not entitled to be released on anticipatory bail.
4. Heard the parties and perused the case diary.
5. Looking to the facts and circumstances of the case, the wife of the applicant is beneficiary of the land and the allegation is against Patwari and no purpose would be served by taking the applicant Mahendra Yadav vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 8 September, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/184667816/
1 into custody, this Court deems it appropriate to enlarge the applicant on anticipatory bail, therefore,
without commenting anything on the merit of the case, the application is allowed.
6.

sentences.text: It is directed that in the event of arrest the applicant- Mahendra Yadav shall be enlarged on bail on furnishing a personal bond in a sum o f Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the Arresting Officer/Trial Court for his appearance before the concerned during the course of investigation or during trial, as the case may be.
7. Applicant is directed to cooperate with the investigating agency and if required by the Police, also appear on the date and time directed by the Investigating Officer.
8. It is further directed that the applicant shall abide by all the conditions as enumerated under Section 482(2) of BNSS.
